title: Format & Strategy
description: Learn how TOEFL ITP Level 1 is built, how it is scored and how to manage time and guessing before you train each section.

id.title: Format & Strategi
id.description: Pahami susunan TOEFL ITP Level 1, cara penilaiannya, serta cara mengatur waktu dan menebak sebelum melatih tiap section.

objectives.text: Name the three sections in order with their question counts and time limits
Describe the parts inside each section (Listening Parts A, B and C; Structure and Written Expression; reading passages)
Explain how TOEFL ITP differs from TOEFL iBT and why institutions use it

id.title: Format TOEFL ITP Level 1
id.summary: Tiga section pilihan ganda, 140 soal, 115 menit.

objectives.name-sections: Menyebutkan tiga section secara berurutan beserta jumlah soal dan batas waktunya
objectives.name-parts: Menjelaskan bagian-bagian di tiap section (Listening Part A, B dan C; Structure dan Written Expression; teks bacaan)
objectives.itp-vs-ibt: Menjelaskan perbedaan TOEFL ITP dengan TOEFL iBT dan alasan institusi memakainya

nodes.title: Scores, Scaling and CEFR
nodes.summary: How correct answers become section scores, a 310–677 total and a CEFR level.

objectives.text: State the section score scales (31–68, 31–68, 31–67) and the total range 310–677
Calculate a total score from three section scores (sum × 10 ÷ 3)
Match a total or section score to the ETS CEFR minimums (A2 343, B1 433, B2 543, C1 620)
Set a realistic target score from an institution's requirement and the score's two-year validity

id.title: Skor, Skala dan CEFR
id.summary: Bagaimana jawaban benar menjadi skor section, total 310–677 dan level CEFR.

objectives.section-scales: Menyebutkan skala skor section (31–68, 31–68, 31–67) dan rentang total 310–677
objectives.total-formula: Menghitung skor total dari tiga skor section (jumlah × 10 ÷ 3)
objectives.cefr-cuts: Mencocokkan skor total atau section dengan batas minimum CEFR dari ETS (A2 343, B1 433, B2 543, C1 620)
objectives.set-target: Menentukan target skor yang realistis berdasarkan syarat institusi dan masa berlaku skor dua tahun

nodes.title: Pacing, Guessing and Elimination
nodes.summary: Answer every question: there is no penalty for guessing.

objectives.text: Explain why every question should be answered (scores count correct answers only; no penalty for guessing)
Eliminate clearly wrong options before choosing the best of four answers
Plan a time budget per section and decide when to skip and return to a question
Follow test-day rules for paper and digital delivery (one answer per question, notes only where allowed, no breaks)

id.title: Tempo, Menebak dan Eliminasi
id.summary: Jawab semua soal: tidak ada pengurangan nilai untuk tebakan.

objectives.no-penalty: Menjelaskan mengapa semua soal harus dijawab (skor hanya menghitung jawaban benar; tebakan tidak dikurangi nilai)
objectives.eliminate: Menyingkirkan opsi yang jelas salah sebelum memilih jawaban terbaik dari empat pilihan
objectives.time-budget: Menyusun anggaran waktu per section dan menentukan kapan melewati soal lalu kembali lagi
objectives.test-day-rules: Mematuhi aturan hari tes untuk versi kertas dan digital (satu jawaban per soal, catatan hanya jika diizinkan, tanpa jeda istirahat)
